description: This Java class 'InputManagerV16' provides a compatibility wrapper around Android's InputManager for API level 16 (Jelly Bean). It manages input device listeners, registers and unregisters them, and provides methods to access input devices.

classes.name: InputManagerV16
classes.description: A wrapper class for InputManager with support for input device listener registration and retrieval methods, targeting API level 16.

classes.name: V16InputDeviceListener
classes.description: An inner class implementing InputManager.InputDeviceListener that delegates events to a user-provided InputDeviceListener.

methods.name: InputManagerV16
methods.description: Constructor that initializes InputManager and the listener map.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Returns the InputDevice corresponding to the provided id.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns the array of input device IDs.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a new input device listener with the system, wrapping it in a V16InputDeviceListener.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters the specified input device listener from the system.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling generic motion events; unused in this version.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Placeholder method for pause handling; unused in this version.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Placeholder method for resume handling; unused in this version.
